panels.description: Sitara scans selected maintenance pages while Nayah watches shaking frost overhead. Leave upper-right for sound effect and lower area for dialogue.
Sitara overlays drilling and ice-motion plots; a red line shows local acceleration without implying global causation. Leave upper-left for dialogue.
Warning light flashes and meltwater beads at the threshold as Nayah pulls the emergency line toward the exit. Leave upper third for command.
Copied record clearly displays NEXUS — ROUTE 2 — SECOND TIMESTAMP and PAIR BEFORE DISCLOSURE. Leave lower area clear.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Then the copy has to be complete.

items.text: Local acceleration. Not the whole system.
